name: V.P.M's R. Z. Shah College Mulund
description:
The College was established in the year 2003 after the State Government gave permission to start college on ‘permanently unaided basis’. It is affiliated to the University of Mumbai. Conveniently located at Mulund (East), on Mithagar Road, it is situated at a walking distance from Mulund station on the Central Railway.

Though it was initially started with BCom and BSc (IT) in 2003, other courses such as BSc (Computer Science), BCom (Banking & Insurance), BMS (Bachelor of Management Studies), BCom (Accounting & Finance), BMM (Bachelor of Mass Media) were added subsequently. The subject of Kannada for BA was introduced in 2009.

The College was renamed as VPM’s Ramniklal Zaveribhai Shah College of Arts Science and Commerce in 2009.

featured_reviews.name: Shriya Mushrif
featured_reviews.review_text:
VPM R. Z. Shah College offers a supportive and positive environment for students’ academic and overall development.

The college has a well-equipped and spacious library with a good collection of books, reference materials, and journals, which is very helpful for studies and exam preparation.

The teaching faculty is knowledgeable, friendly, and cooperative. Professors explain concepts clearly and encourage students to ask questions. The non-teaching staff is also helpful and cooperative, making administrative work smooth and stress-free. The college campus and classrooms are clean, well-maintained, and provide a pleasant atmosphere for learning.

The college also focuses on modern teaching methods. Smart boards and advanced teaching technology are used in classrooms, which makes lectures more interactive, interesting, and easier to understand.

The NSS unit of the college is very active and plays an important role in students’ social development. In my first year, I attended many NSS activities related to social service, awareness programs, and community work, which helped me understand the importance of social responsibility.
In my second year, I became a core member of NSS and got opportunities to organize and manage various events. This experience improved my leadership skills, confidence, and teamwork.

The NSS camp was very successful and gave me many beautiful memories and valuable life lessons.

Overall, VPM R. Z. Shah College is a good choice for students who want quality education along with opportunities for social service and personal growth.

The first day was a blast, starting with a cleanliness drive that set the tone for the rest of the camp. 😊 It was incredible to see everyone come together to make a difference in the village.

featured_reviews.name: Pritam Rajpurohit
featured_reviews.review_text: VPM's R. Z. Shah College of Arts, Science and Commerce is generally considered a decent, above-average college in Mumbai with an overall positive reputation among students. The college offers good academic support with helpful and approachable faculty, and it has fairly well-maintained facilities like computer labs and a library, though some classrooms and washrooms may need improvement. Campus life is active, with regular cultural events, sports, and extracurricular activities that give students good exposure beyond studies. However, placements are only average, and many students prefer to pursue higher education after graduation. The admission process is relatively smooth, and the environment is calm and suitable for learning. Overall, it is a good option for students seeking balanced academics and college life, especially if they are unable to secure admission in top-tier Mumbai colleges.

featured_reviews.name: Rishikesh Tripathi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am proud to be an alumnus of VPM R.Z. Shah College, BMS Batch 2019. My journey here has shaped not only my academic life but also my personality, leadership, and career.

As an NSS Leader, this college gave me countless opportunities to express myself, develop confidence, and grow as a responsible citizen. I participated in leadership training sessions, disaster management programs, community engagement drives, state-level activities, and many more life-changing experiences. These opportunities built my management skills, analytical thinking, discipline, and teamwork.

I am extremely grateful to our Principal, Dr. Kavita Sharma, whose enthusiastic leadership and inspiring guidance encouraged students like me to come forward, speak confidently, and learn life lessons beyond textbooks. She always motivated us by saying that quality education and good values create true human beings.

My heartfelt appreciation to all my mentors and faculty members who consistently supported us, trained us, and reminded us that India is growing fast — and skill development is the key. Their constant encouragement helped me become who I am today.

Though our college is located a bit away from the central areas, the quality of education, values, and opportunities here are unmatched. I even had the honor of representing the college at state-level events, and was awarded the Best Camper of the Year 2018 — a moment of immense pride.

Today, I run a registered non-profit organization, Ayushman Foundation, which works for education, health, and community development. Whatever I am today — a responsible human being, a leader, and a social worker — is because of the strong foundation my college and my mentors gave me. This college did not just educate me; it shaped my identity and character.
I will always feel grateful and proud to say that I am a student of VPM R.Z. Shah College.
